title: RV32I core designed from specification
objective: Design RV32I cores from the specification alone, verify them against independent ground truth, and measure the verification workflow itself so that changes to the workflow can be shown to help rather than asserted to.

scope.primary_claim: A candidate core implements the RV32I base integer instruction set as specified, demonstrated by exact architectural-state agreement with an independent reference over a stimulus corpus whose detection power has been measured.
scope.secondary_claim: The verification workflow's ability to detect defects is quantified by mutation score, so a workflow change is accepted on evidence.
included: RV32I base integer instruction set, machine mode only
instruction encoding conformance against official machine-readable tables
instruction-accurate differential comparison of architectural state
functional coverage of instructions and named corner cases
mutation testing of the verification workflow
excluded: privileged architecture, CSRs, interrupts, and exceptions beyond ECALL/EBREAK
the M, A, F, D, and C extensions
misaligned memory access, which this profile traps rather than emulates
any timing, power, or area claim for a named technology
any claim that a passing corpus proves correctness rather than the absence of observed disagreement
scope.completion_boundary: Simulation-complete means every instruction and corner bin is covered, the differential corpus agrees exactly, and the workflow's mutation score is reported with every survivor either killed or shown to be an equivalent mutant.

allowed_strategies: any hazard resolution strategy: stalling, forwarding, or speculation
non_requirements: a particular pipeline depth or memory protocol
performance targets before a target technology is frozen
invariants: x0 reads as zero and discards writes
architectural state after each retired instruction matches the reference exactly
an instruction the specification does not define must not be executed silently
unmeasured metrics remain null rather than estimated

workloads.description: Every encoder output is checked against the official machine-readable field positions and constant values, without executing anything.

workloads.source: hand-written programs targeting specific immediate bit positions
workloads.description: Far branches and jumps that set immediate bits random stimulus cannot reach, and extreme immediates for every format.
workloads.comparison: exact architectural state after each retired instruction

workloads.source: hand-written producer/consumer programs at every pipeline distance
workloads.description: Forwarding distances, load-use interlocks, squashed writers, and control dependencies.
workloads.comparison: exact architectural state after each retired instruction

workloads.source: block-structured constrained-random generation from a pinned seed
workloads.description: Terminating random programs whose control-flow targets are block boundaries, with signed memory offsets around a centred data pointer.
workloads.comparison: first divergence in control flow, fetched instruction, or register state

workloads.source: a catalogue of realistic single-point defects injected into the RTL
workloads.description: Measures what fraction of injected defects the workflow detects, and how many programs each detection takes.
workloads.comparison: mutation score, with every survivor classified as a stimulus gap or an equivalent mutant

workloads.description: Per-instruction proof obligations plus register, pc, uniqueness, and causality consistency checks, with memory responses left unconstrained.
workloads.comparison: bounded model checking; no counterexample within each check's configured depth

requirements: every encoder output conforms to the official encoding tables
architectural state agrees exactly after every retired instruction
control flow agrees exactly, including branch direction and jump targets
every RV32I instruction and every declared corner bin is covered by the corpus
every surviving mutant is classified, and an equivalence claim is supported by measurement rather than by argument alone
forbidden_shortcuts: comparing against a reference that shares an implementation with the design under test
letting the testbench model instruction semantics or perform the comparison
reporting a passing corpus without reporting what it covered
accepting a workflow change on plausibility rather than on a measured change in detection
recording an unkillable mutant as killed, or a stimulus gap as an equivalent mutant
correctness.unknown_policy: Ground truth beyond reach of this host, including the official architectural compliance suite and the Sail formal model, is recorded as unavailable with the reason, never treated as passed.

metrics.meaning: Every program in the corpus agrees exactly with the reference.
RV32I instructions the corpus actually executed.
Named corner situations the corpus actually reached.
Injected defects detected, reported separately for killable and equivalent mutants.
Detection latency per defect; the cost of finding a bug once it exists.
Measured on the RTL for the executed corpus; not a performance claim for any target.
Generic cell counts only until a target library is frozen.

criteria: every encoder output matches the official machine-readable tables
no base RV32I instruction is missing from the encoder
every RV32I instruction is executed by the corpus
every declared corner bin is reached by the corpus
the whole corpus agrees exactly with the independent reference
a mutation campaign has been run and its score reported
every surviving mutant is classified as a stimulus gap or an equivalent mutant
each equivalence claim is supported by measurement, not by argument alone
results are confirmed against an implementation this repository did not write
any ground truth that could not be run is recorded as unavailable with its reason
per-instruction semantics are proven, not sampled

exit_criteria: the encoder conforms to the official tables
the reference model executes the specification's examples
the differential loop runs end to end
every instruction and corner bin is covered
mutation score is reported and every survivor classified
the measured workflow is applied to a materially harder microarchitecture
agreement confirmed against an implementation written elsewhere
every generated proof obligation passes, or is recorded as inapplicable with its reason

provenance_requirements: record the specification revision and the ground-truth sources used
record the stimulus generator version and seed range for every campaign
record mutation score together with the catalogue it was measured against
keep coverage and agreement as separate numbers; a passing corpus that covers little is not evidence
record which ground truths were unavailable and why
